posts.text: Is Jacob Misiorowski available out of the bullpen for the Brewers tonight? “Could be,” Pat Murphy said. “It won’t be ‘just because,’ you know? We’ve got to be smart about it and look at the situation. But I think our pitching’s in good shape.”

posts.text: Erik Sabrowski enters for Williams and sets down Murakami swinging to end a bases-loaded threat. Williams ties Charles Nagy's franchise record for strikeouts in a postseason game, going 5 2/3 IP, 1 H, 2 BB, 12 K, 1 HBP in a performance that will live on in Cleveland lore.

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Petey Halpin just launched a baseball and chucked his bat basically as high into the air. 2-run shot. 3-2 Cleveland.
posts.jp: ピーティー・ハルピンが打った瞬間、バットをほぼ真上に放り投げた。2ランで3-2、クリーブランドが勝ち越し。

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: You and your 42,000 closest friends can watch tonight’s NLCS Game 4 on a really, really big TV. www.mlb.com/news/brewers...
posts.jp: 今夜のリーグ優勝決定シリーズ第4戦は、4万2000人の仲間と超大型ビジョンで観戦できる。

posts.author: Sam Dykstra
posts.text: The Brewers are one win away from their first-ever NL pennant. They’re one win away from their first pennant of any kind since 1982.
posts.jp: ブルワーズが球団史上初のナ・リーグ優勝まであと1勝。1982年以来となるリーグ優勝まで、あと1勝だ。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: From @jaysonst.bsky.social: The Phillies requested to interview to Chase Utley and Raul Ibañez for manager job. They said thanks but no thanks. More here: www.nytimes.com/athletic/769...
posts.jp: @jaysonst.bsky.socialより：フィリーズは監督候補としてチェイス・アトリーとラウル・イバニェスに面談を打診したが、2人とも辞退。

posts.text: “Milwaukee, you have a World Series!” www.mlb.com/news/brewers...
posts.jp: 「ミルウォーキー、君たちにはワールドシリーズがある！」

posts.text: From my mom: Dad’s hat
posts.jp: 母から：父の帽子

posts.text: Former Astros manager Joe Espada posted this on Instagram this evening
posts.jp: 元アストロズ監督のジョー・エスパダが今夜、Instagramにこれを投稿した

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: Ohtani's 1st HR in nearly two months was not enough for LA in NLCS loss www.mlb.com/news/shohei-...
posts.jp: 大谷翔平、約2カ月ぶりの本塁打も届かず ドジャースはNLCSで敗退

posts.author: Adam McCalvy
posts.text: My favorite anecdote within the story of how far the Brewers came to win the NL pennant: This cake, anonymously sent to the front office in 2015. 1. That someone sent it. 2. That they actually ate it. www.mlb.com/news/brewers...
posts.jp: ブルワーズがナ・リーグ優勝を勝ち取るまでの道のりで、いちばん好きなエピソード。2015年、フロントオフィスに匿名で届いたこのケーキ。①誰かが送ってきたこと。②本当に食べたこと。

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: MLB officially says Game 4 will start in a delay. As you expected.
posts.jp: MLBが公式に、第4戦は遅れて開始すると発表。予想どおりです。

posts.text: Rain delay theater: hit me with questions about the Guardians or whatever is on your mind ⬇️
